name: BACH_0221
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (85%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second model agrees, and 4 of 5 similar cases match.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 85%, Invasive 12% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 100th pct | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu | Mostly supportive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; fits in situ rather than invasion [F2] · Weak
- **Scant benign stroma or fat** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; small invasive association [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 5, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; modest weight in concept model · Validated
- **Nuclear size** (regions 3, 8, 9) · context · Mean 44 µm², lowest in reference; size variation highest [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. Unreliable here: necrosis, normal lobules, mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Invasive probability is 12%; regions 8 and 9 carry the highest per-region risk (24%, 15%).
- Similar case BACH_0166 is Invasive (similarity 0.75); it differs most in pleomorphism.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 11** — confirm atypical cells stay within ducts, with no stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 8, 9** — highest per-region invasive risk; look for stromal invasion.
3. **Region 3** — strongest heatmap weight toward invasive; check stroma and lobule architecture.
